name: Guess How Many
desc:
Welcome to Guess How Many!

Just a simple little game 😊
Each round the jar will be filled with a random item 🍭🍬🍪⚽️
Guess how many items are in the jar to earn coins 🤔❓💰
Use coins to choose the next item! 💰
You can also choose one of many crazy ways for the jar to be filled! 

Complete daily challenges to earn awesome rewards.
Unlock and equip cute Jar pets to follow you around.

Free VIP Servers so have fun with your friends!

👍If you enjoy the game press the like button!
⭐Don't forget to favorite!
🙌🏻Join Hidden Power up for updates on the game

Thanks so much!

If you have suggestions or find bugs please let me know.  Thanks!
